independently_discovered_opportunities: Complete the safe local inspection half of the Journey Handoff workflow without opening portal transfer.
Convert the observed backlog-collapse and evidence-reference weakness into a deterministic release invariant.

product_platform_improvements.problem: A downloaded handoff pack could not be verified locally for integrity, expiry, exact fields, or central destination compatibility.
product_platform_improvements.implementation: Added a browser-only JSON inspector with a 16 KB limit, exact field allowlists, Web Crypto integrity verification, expiry/future-time checks, central destination-category compatibility, fixed next-step guidance, accessible live status, and local reset.
product_platform_improvements.before_state: Users could create and download a minimal pack but had no built-in way to verify it later.
product_platform_improvements.after_state: Users can create, download, and locally inspect a pack while network transfer, persistent storage, automatic opening, and portal import remain disabled.
product_platform_improvements.benefit: A returning user can detect tampering, expiry, unsupported fields, and destination mismatch without uploading the pack or re-entering sensitive facts.
limitations: Central compatibility is guidance only and does not prove that any destination portal imported or accepted the pack.
The inspector does not calculate deadlines, determine eligibility, provide legal advice, or persist inspection history.

builder_prompt_system_improvements.problem: The V12 dual-track gate validated report shape but did not verify referenced files/tests, exact source identity, prior limitations, or preservation of the full unresolved backlog.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.implementation: Added a deterministic release-evidence coverage contract and validator that checks current version/source/packet identity, expected command counts, referenced files and tests, package-script inclusion, all 21 carried-forward backlog IDs, prior limitation dispositions, current evidence files, and non-circular candidate/final identity boundaries.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.before_state: A structurally valid report could cite missing evidence or silently drop unresolved work.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.after_state: The ordinary release fails closed when evidence references are missing, source identity is stale, prior limitations are unreviewed, or any required backlog item disappears without an evidence-backed disposition.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.future_build_benefit: Future builders receive an executable evidence-completeness and carry-forward invariant before candidate packaging.
limitations: The gate verifies repository evidence consistency; it does not prove external provider, production, device, legal-review, or accessibility acceptance.

accepted_innovation_waves: Release evidence and backlog coverage gate

reverted_or_rejected_innovation_waves.wave: Destination portal import or automatic handoff
reverted_or_rejected_innovation_waves.reason: Exact product-local acceptance and separate authorization remain absent.

lessons_carried_forward: Advance only the next safe maturity slice when a product-local integration boundary is not accepted.
Convert a regression that almost removed durable obligations into a deterministic invariant rather than relying on manual care.

prior_limitations_reviewed.evidence: Local inspection explicitly reports portal_import_accepted=false and never opens or transmits to a destination.
Coverage validation remains repository-scoped and deploymentAuthorized=false.

deferred_opportunities_with_exact_reason.reason: Requires one exact destination artifact, product-local schema acceptance, privacy/security review, and owner authority.
Requires separate shoulder-surfing, payload, offline decoding, print, camera, and assistive-technology acceptance.

next_innovation_opportunities: Pilot one product-local import adapter only after exact portal acceptance.
Add a privacy-reviewed QR representation only after real-device and shoulder-surfing acceptance.
Add transparent candidate scoring only after a human-readable rubric cannot override hard safety constraints.
